Prompt: More and more people are choosing to work from home. Why is this happening? Is it a positive or
negative development?
Nowadays, more and more people are choosing to work from home instead of going to the oﬃce. This essay
will discuss why this is happening and whether it is a positive or negative development. In my opinion, it is a
positive development.
There are several reasons why people work from home. Firstly, the internet is much faster than before, so
people can have meetings online and send documents easily. Secondly, many companies want to save money
on oﬃces, because renting an oﬃce in the city is very expensive. Moreover, many workers do not want to travel
to work every day, because the traﬃc is bad and it takes a lot of time. Therefore, working from home is
becoming more popular.
I think working from home is a positive development for several reasons. Firstly, people can save time and
money because they do not need to travel. For example, a friend of mine used to spend two hours a day on the
bus, but now she uses this time to exercise and cook. Secondly, people can spend more time with their family,
for example by having lunch with their children or looking after their parents. However, some people feel lonely
when they work at home alone, and it is diﬃcult to stop working in the evening. But I think these problems are
not very serious if people are careful.
In conclusion, people work from home because of the internet, the cost of oﬃces and the traﬃc. I believe this is
a positive development because it saves time and gives people more time with their families.

1. Rewrite Body 1 using Priority 1 only. Keep your clear position.
2. Then write a new essay on a diﬀerent prompt within a week, on the 40-minute clock.
3. With an Intermediate report, we read both: the revised paragraph shows whether you can make the ﬁx, and
the new essay shows whether it holds on a new prompt.
